c74object.name: evi_counting
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_counting.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_counting.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
Phasors, rates, ramps, all with zero reset functionality and various other features such as spread, reverse, pause, phase, jump, etc. For replicating some MSP functionality inside gen~.

entry.name: eviPhasor0 ( )
entry.description:
Optionally zero reset phasor with pause, reverse and phase, @see [evi.phasor0~] for a patched version
In 1: type=input: frequency, Phasor frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: reset, Trigger, naive phase reset
In 3: type=Param (optional): minimumhz, default: 0.125, min: 0, max: 1, Set minimum Hz for zero reset behaviour
In 4: type=Param (optional): mode, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Zero reset behaviour off/on
In 5: type=Param (optional): reverse, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Reverse allowed?
In 6: type=Param (optional): pause, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Pause current ramp off/on
In 7: type=Param (optional): phase, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Set to this phase on next reset
Return 1: thisphasor, Phase 0..1
Return 2: zero reset Hz, Current frequency in Hz
Return 3: thisdelta, Phasor sync signal

entry.name: eviPhasorTwo0 ( )
entry.description:
Two synchronous optionally zero reset phasors with spread control
In 1: type=input: freqFree, Phasors frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: spreadFree, Spread phase amount 0..1
In 3: type=input: reset, Trigger, naive phase reset
In 4: type=param (optional): minimumhz, default: 0.125, Set minimum Hz for zero reset behaviour
In 5: type=param (optional): mode, default: 1, Zero reset behaviour off/on
Return 1: thisPhasor1, Phase 1 0..1
Return 2: thisPhasor2, Phase 2 0..1
Return 3: freqMain, Current frequency in Hz
Return 4: spreadMain, Current spread 0..1
Return 5: thisPhasor1Sync, Phasor 1 sync signal
Return 6: thisPhasor2Sync, Phasor 2 sync signal

entry.name: eviPhasorRate0 ( )
entry.description:
Optionally zero reset synchronous phasor and rate combo, with pause, reverse and phase
In 1: type=input: frequency, Main phasor frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: rate, Main rate multiplier around 1==input
In 3: type=input: reset, Trigger, naive phase reset
In 4: type=Param (optional): minimumhz, default: 0.125, min: 0, max: 1, Set minimum Hz for zero reset behaviour
In 5: type=Param (optional): mode, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Zero reset behaviour off/on
In 6: type=Param (optional): reverse, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Reverse allowed?
In 7: type=Param (optional): pause, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Pause current ramp off/on
In 8: type=Param (optional): phase, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Set to this phase on next reset
Return 1: thisphasor, Phase 0..1
Return 2: thisrate, Rate 0..1
Return 3: currentfrequency, Current frequency in Hz
Return 4: currentrate, Current rate multiplier
Return 5: thisdelta, Phasor sync signal
Return 6: ratedelta, Rate sync signal

entry.name: eviRamp0 ( )
entry.description:
A bit like MSP [ramp~], optionally zero reset oneshot or looping ramp/phasor with numerous control features
In 1: type=input: trig, Audio rate ramp trigger
In 2: type=Param (optional): duration, default: 1000, min: 0, max: 60000, Ramp duration in ms
In 3: type=Param (optional): zeroreset, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Zero reset phase off/on 0/1
In 4: type=Param (optional): retrigger, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Allow retriggering of ramp during ramp off/on 0/1
In 5: type=Param (optional): loop, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Loop ramp off/on 0/1 (@loop 1 = a phasor)
In 6: type=Param (optional): restingstate, default: 1, min: 0, max: 1, Oneshot mode (@loop=0) 'rests' at zero or one 0/1
In 7: type=Param (optional): curve, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Make ramp s-curve off/on 0/1
In 8: type=Param (optional): pause, default: 0, min: 0, max: 1, Pause ramp output 0/1
Return 1: outramp, Ramp 0..1
Return 2: carrycount, How many ramps since last reset
Return 3: syncstart, Sync trigger at start of a ramp
Return 4: syncend, Sync trigger at end of a ramp
